newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFM transfers milk and juices to Selecta.
newsitem.headline: RFM transfers milk and juices to Selecta.

text.p: Philippine food conglomerate RFM Corp said on Wednesday its board had approved the transfer of the firm's milk and juices division to its ice cream unit Selecta Dairy Products Inc.
RFM said in a statement it would swap the assets of the milk and juices division, worth 380 million pesos, for 190 million convertible preferred shares of Selecta.
Under the terms of the swap, the convertible preferred shares would be priced at two pesos each at a coupon rate of five percent yearly.

RFM President Jose Concepcion said he expected Selecta's net income in calendar year 1997 to reach 150 million pesos this year from the earlier estimate of 110 million with the transfer of RFM's milk and juices division.
In previous years, Selecta used to report its financial performance based on fiscal year ending June 30.
"Starting 1997, Selecta will convert to calendar year reporting," said an RFM official, who asked not to be named.
